claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect / grant_spell_access
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants Divine Smite as an always-prepared spell. The v4 atom `grant_spell_access` exists, but there is no `ClassFeatureEffect` variant that can express it. The current surface only has `grant_extra_action` and `heal_hp`.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect / cast_named_spell_free
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a free cast of a specific named spell (Divine Smite) without expending a spell slot, with a use-count resource and long-rest reset. No existing `ClassFeatureEffect` variant can express 'cast spell X without slot'. This is mechanically distinct from `grant_extra_action` or `heal_hp`.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast it without expending a spell slot, but you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics dual-effect support (passive + activated)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: This feature has two behaviors in one SRD entry: a passive always-on spell-access grant and an activated free-cast resource. The current `ClassFeatureActivationMechanics` supports exactly one `effect` field. Honest encoding requires either a way to attach a passive grant alongside the activation, or a richer `effects` list.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared. In addition, you can cast it without expending a spell slot, but you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.
